answer.book: A single 1616 Latin work with front matter: a title page and a dedicatory epistle to Johann ab Ulm, followed by the main text, Lubbertus's letter 'Censura Epistolaris' against Remonstrant semi-Pelagianism, with quotations from Augustine as running heads and an errata list at the end.

entries.title: D. Johanni ab Ulmis, Illustriß. Principis ac Domini, D. Georgii-Friderici, Marchionis Badensis, &c. Consiliario, & Exprę-secto Rœtelano
Gratiani Civilis Censura Epistolaris, De Capitibus 5 Remonstrantium Batavorum, in causâ Prædestinationis, eique connexis articulis: Pro sententiâ B. Augustini, contra Semipelagianos.
